messages.content: If Ann is 9 years old, her brother is twice her age and her sister is 3 years younger than her, how old will her brother be in 3 years?

content.text:
Ann is 9, her brother is 2 × 9 = **18**.

In 3 years, her brother will be 18 + 3 = **21 years old**.
